data.name: StreamNotFoundException
data.comment: The exception message for when a requested stream does not exist. Parameter {0}: stream name.

data.name: StreamDeletedException
data.value: Stream '{0}' has been soft deleted. It will not be visible in the stream list, until it is restored by appending to it again.
data.comment: The exception message for when a requested stream has been deleted. Parameter {0}: stream name.

data.name: StreamAlreadyExistsException
data.comment: The exception message for when attempting to create a stream that already exists.

data.name: StreamTombstonedException
data.value: Stream '{0}' has been tombstoned. It has been permanently removed from the system and cannot be restored.
data.comment: The exception message for when attempting to access a tombstoned stream. Parameter {0}: stream name.

data.name: StreamRevisionConflictException
data.value: {0} failed due to a revision conflict on stream '{1}'. Expected revision: {2}. Actual revision: {3}.
data.comment: The exception message for when expected stream revision does not match actual revision. Parameter {0}: operation name (Delete/Tombstone), {1}: stream name, {2}: expected revision, {3}: actual revision.

data.name: MaxAppendRecordSizeExceededException
data.comment: The exception message for when a record exceeds the maximum allowed size for append operations.

data.name: MaxAppendTransactionSizeExceededException
data.comment: The exception message for when an append transaction exceeds the maximum allowed size.

data.name: StreamAlreadyInAppendSessionException
data.value: Stream is already in an append session.
data.comment: The exception message for when attempting to start an append session on a stream that already has an active session.

data.name: AppendSessionNoRequestsException
data.comment: The exception message for when an append session is submitted without any records.

data.name: LeaderForwardingTimeoutException
data.comment: The exception message for when a request forwarded to the leader node times out.

data.name: ServerNotReadyException
data.value: Server is not ready to process requests.
data.comment: The exception message for when the server is not in a ready state to handle operations.

data.name: ServerOverloadedException
data.comment: The exception message for when the server is overloaded and cannot process additional requests.

data.name: NotLeaderNodeException
data.value: The current node is not the leader.
data.comment: The exception message for when an operation requires the leader node but the current node is not the leader.

data.name: ConnectionStringNoScheme
data.value: Could not parse scheme from connection string.
data.comment: The exception message for when no scheme is found in the connection string.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidScheme
data.comment: The exception message for when an unsupported scheme is specified.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidUserCredentials
data.comment: The exception message for when user credentials are not properly formatted as username:password.

data.name: ConnectionStringNoEndpoints
data.value: Connection string must specify at least one endpoint.
data.comment: The exception message for when no host endpoints are specified.

data.name: ConnectionStringMultipleHostsDirectScheme
data.value: Direct connection scheme does not support multiple hosts.
data.comment: The exception message for when multiple hosts are specified with a direct connection scheme.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidPath
data.comment: The exception message for when a path other than empty or forward slash is specified.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidHost
data.comment: The exception message for when a host endpoint is malformed.

data.name: ConnectionStringDuplicateKey
data.value: Duplicate parameter key in connection string.
data.comment: The exception message for when a parameter key is specified more than once.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidKeyValuePair
data.comment: The exception message for when a parameter is not properly formatted as key=value.

data.name: ConnectionStringUnknownOption
data.comment: The exception message for when an unrecognized option is specified.

data.name: ConnectionStringIntegerRequired
data.value: Connection string option must be an integer value.
data.comment: The exception message for when an integer value is required but cannot be parsed.

data.name: ConnectionStringBooleanRequired
data.value: Connection string option must be either true or false.
data.comment: The exception message for when a boolean value is required but cannot be parsed.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidNodePreference
data.comment: The exception message for when node preference is not a valid value (leader, follower, random, readonlyreplica).

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidKeepAliveInterval
data.comment: The exception message for when keep-alive interval is not a valid value (-1 or >= 0).

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalidKeepAliveTimeout
data.comment: The exception message for when keep-alive timeout is not a valid value (-1 or >= 0).

data.name: ConnectionStringCertificateNotFound
data.comment: The exception message for when specified certificate file does not exist.

data.name: ConnectionStringCertificateInvalidFormat
data.comment: The exception message for when certificate file cannot be loaded due to invalid format.

data.name: ConnectionStringCertificateBothFilesRequired
data.value: Both certificate and key files must be specified.
data.comment: The exception message for when only one of UserCertFile or UserKeyFile is provided.

data.name: ConnectionStringCertificateFileNotFound
data.value: Specified certificate file does not exist.
data.comment: The exception message for when UserCertFile path does not exist.

data.name: ConnectionStringKeyFileNotFound
data.value: Specified key file does not exist.
data.comment: The exception message for when UserKeyFile path does not exist.

data.name: ConnectionStringCertificateCreationFailed
data.comment: The exception message for when certificate creation fails.

data.name: InitializeException
data.comment: The exception message for when IRecordProcessor.Initialize callback throws an exception.

data.name: ProcessRecordsException
data.comment: The exception message for when IRecordProcessor.ProcessRecords callback throws an exception.

data.name: CheckpointException
data.comment: The exception message for when IRecordProcessor.OnCheckpoint callback throws an exception.

data.name: AssignmentChangeException
data.comment: The exception message for when IRecordProcessor.OnAssignmentChange callback throws an exception.

data.name: ShutdownException
data.comment: The exception message for when IRecordProcessor.OnShutdown callback throws an exception.
